items.hed: Texans are on the road Sunday at Tennessee, noon Central
items.insight: The Houston Texans schedule lists Sunday, Oct. 11, as an away game at the Tennessee Titans, Nissan Stadium in Nashville, noon Central, on CBS. The next listed date is Sunday, Oct. 18, at Jacksonville in London, 8:30 a.m. Central. The club page does not print a final for the Oct. 4 home game against Dallas.

items.hed: Astros still have no general manager as Espada's contract runs out this month
items.insight: MLB.com reports the club parted ways with general manager Dana Brown on Aug. 24. Assistant general managers Charles Cook, Gavin Dickey, and Connor Huff, with senior advisor Jeff Bagwell, have carried the work, and owner Jim Crane is overseeing baseball operations. Nearly a week after the White Sox eliminated Houston in two games in the American League Wild Card Series, MLB.com says the search is unchanged. Manager Joe Espada's contract expires at the end of October. He said last week he would like to return. No decision is posted.

items.hed: Rockets play the Mavericks in Macao today, with a second game there Sunday
items.insight: The Rockets' game page lists Friday, Oct. 9, against the Dallas Mavericks in Macao. The club lists a second preseason game there on Sunday, Oct. 11. Rosters for opening day are set Oct. 19 at 5 p.m. Eastern. The regular season starts Oct. 20. No final is posted on the club page this morning. The Friday game is on the card, not in the books.
